annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1646 of 17 August 2023 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/76 as regards harmonised standards on safety rules for the construction and installation of lifts
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1646 of 17 August 2023 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/76 as regards harmonised standards on safety rules for the construction and installation of lifts
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 206/70
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision updating the list of harmonised standards for lifts under Directive 2014/33/EU, adding revised EN 81-21, -28, -58, -70 and -77 (2022) and deferring withdrawal of the older versions. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Annex I of Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/76 to list revised EN 81 lift standards.
Revised standards confer presumption of conformity with Directive 2014/33/EU.
Old standard references deleted from 21 February 2025.
Enters into force on day of publication.
